\section{List of symbols}\label{app:B.1}

The list holds the symbols first used in Volume~I; a symbol first used in another volume is listed there. Each symbol is listed once, under the chapter or appendix in which it first appears; the last column gives that section.
The Units column gives the dimension in natural units ($\hbar = c = k_{\mathrm{B}} = 1$, \cref{app:A.1}) and, after a
semicolon, the conventional unit in which values are quoted. The entry 1 marks a dimensionless quantity, and a dash an
object without a dimension of its own, such as an operator, a state or a label.

$H^{\mathrm{TB}}(k)$, $S^{\mathrm{ov}}(k)$ & Tight-binding Hamiltonian and overlap matrices between Bloch sums & $\mathrm{eV}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:3.2} \\

$V_{\mathrm{KS}}$, $v_{\mathrm{xc}}$, $E_{\mathrm{xc}}$ & Kohn--Sham potential, exchange--correlation potential and energy & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:3.4} \\

$\tau$ & Imaginary time, $0 \le \tau \le \beta$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.7} \\
$\omega^{\mathrm{F}}_{j}$, $\omega^{\mathrm{B}}_{j}$ & Fermionic $(2j + 1)\pi T$ and bosonic $2j\pi T$ Matsubara frequencies & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.7} \\

$d_{\vect{Q}}$, $\omega_{\vect{Q}}$, $\phi_{\vect{Q}}$, $g(Q)$ & Generic boson mode $\vect{Q}$, its energy, its field $d_{\vect{Q}} + d^{\dagger}_{-Q}$ and its coupling to electrons, $g(-\vect{Q}) = g(\vect{Q})^{*}$ & ---; $\mathrm{eV}$; ---; $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.8} \\

$F_{\lambda}(r)$, $F_{ns}$ & Exciton envelope function in the relative coordinate, $\Vol^{-1/2}\sum_{k}A^{\lambda}_{\vect{k}}\ee^{\ii \vect{k}\cdot r}, \int |F|^{2} = 1$; hydrogenic envelope & $\text{\AA}^{-3/2}$ & \labelcref{sec:4.9} \\

$\Delta x$, $A(E)$, $w_{p}$ & Shift of the equilibrium coordinate between the two surfaces; absorption line shape of the displaced oscillator; weight of the line $E_{\mathrm{ZPL}} + p\omega_{0}$ & $\text{\AA}$; $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$I_{p}(z)$ & Modified Bessel function of the first kind & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$E_{\mathrm{ZPL}}$ & Zero-phonon-line energy of a color center & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$\ell_{0}$ & Zero-point length $(2M\omega_{0})^{-1/2}$ of a single oscillator of mass $M$ and frequency $\omega_{0}$ & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.6} \\
$\gamma_{\vect{Q}\nu}$, $\gamma^{\mathrm{anh}}_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Phonon linewidth (full width); its anharmonic part & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$\eta_{\mathrm{anh}}$ & Anharmonic small parameter & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$V^{(3)}(1, 2, 3)$ & Three-phonon vertex, an energy; the labels $i = (Q_{i}\nu_{i})$ & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$H_{3}$ & Cubic part of the nuclear Hamiltonian in phonon fields ($H_{N}$ is the harmonic part) & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$\Delta\omega^{\mathrm{anh}}_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ & Anharmonic frequency shift & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$\gamma_{\mathrm{\Gamma},\mathrm{opt}}$, $\gamma^{\mathrm{anh}}_{\mathrm{\Gamma},\mathrm{opt}}$ & Width (FWHM) and anharmonic width of the zone-center optical phonon of silicon ($\gamma_{\vect{Q}\nu}$ at $\vect{Q} = \varGamma, \nu =$ opt) & $\mathrm{meV}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$\mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{trial}}$, $V_{\mathrm{trial}}$, $\delta X_{a}$ & Free energy and potential of the SCHA trial Hamiltonian $H_{\mathrm{trial}}$; displacement $X_{a} - \bar{X}_{a}$ from the centroid & $\mathrm{eV}$; $\mathrm{eV}$; $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$\varepsilon^{\alpha\beta}$ & Homogeneous strain tensor of the quasi-harmonic argument & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$\rho_{\mathrm{pair}}(\omega_{1})$ & Two-phonon density of final states resolved by the energy of one daughter, $N^{-1}\sum \delta(\omega_{1} - \omega_{\vect{Q}\nu_{1}})\delta(\omega_{\mathrm{opt}} - \omega_{\vect{Q}\nu_{1}} - \omega_{\vect{Q}\nu_{2}})$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{-2}$ & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\
$S_{\mathrm{ent}}$ & Entropy & 1 & \labelcref{sec:5.7} \\

$\vect{\rho}$, $\vect{R}_{\mathrm{cm}}$ & Relative coordinate $\vect{r}_{e} - \vect{X}$ and center of mass $(m_{p}\vect{X} + m_{e}\vect{r}_{e})/M_{\mathrm{H}}$ of the hydrogen atom; $\vect{\rho}_{e}$ and $\vect{R}_{\mathrm{cm}}$ of a many-electron atom with the mass $m_{A}$ & $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.1} \\

$\partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}v_{\mathrm{KS}}$, $v_{\mathrm{KS}}$ & Lattice-periodic part of the potential change, $\partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}V_{\mathrm{KS}} = \ee^{\ii Q\cdot \vect{r}}\partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}v_{\mathrm{KS}}$ (lower-case $v$ marks the periodic part) & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$\Delta_{\vect{Q}\nu} v_{\mathrm{KS}}$ & Mass-weighted mode potential $\sum_{\kappa\alpha}(M_{\mathrm{cell}}/M_{\kappa})^{1/2}\ee^{\alpha}_{\kappa\nu} \partial_{\kappa\alpha,Q}v_{\mathrm{KS}}$; $g_{mn\nu} = \ell_{\vect{Q}\nu}\langle u_{m,\vect{k}+\vect{Q}}|\Delta_{\vect{Q}\nu} v_{\mathrm{KS}}|u_{n\vect{k}}\rangle_{\Omega}$ & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$S_{\alpha\beta}$, $E_{1}$ & Strain tensor $\tfrac{1}{2}(\partial_{\alpha}u_{\beta} + \partial_{\beta}u_{\alpha})$ of a long acoustic wave; isotropic deformation potential $\Omega\partial \varepsilon_{n}/\partial \Omega$ (Bardeen--Shockley) & 1; $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$\Xi_{d}$, $\Xi_{u}$, $\hat{k}_{\mathrm{c}}$ & Herring--Vogt dilatation and uniaxial deformation potentials of a conduction valley; unit vector along the valley axis & $\mathrm{eV}$; 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\

$\vect{t}$, $\hat{T}_{\vect{t}}$ & Rigid translation of the whole crystal; its translation operator $\ee^{-\ii \vect{t}\cdot \hat{p}}$ & $\text{\AA}$; --- & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\
$g^{W}$, $\vect{R}_{e}$, $\vect{R}_{p}$ & Real-space (Wannier-gauge) electron--phonon matrix $g^{W}_{m'n'\kappa\alpha}(\vect{R}_{e}, \vect{R}_{p})$; lattice vectors of the electron hop and of the displaced atom & $\mathrm{eV}\,\text{\AA}^{-1}$; $\text{\AA}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.2} \\

$\varepsilon^{\mathrm{ren}}_{n\vect{k}}$ & Phonon-renormalized band energy & $\mathrm{eV}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.3} \\

$\lambda_{\mathrm{ep}}$ & Electron--phonon coupling constant $2\int \dd \omega \alpha^{2}F(\omega)/\omega$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.4} \\
$\mathsf{D}_{\nu}(Q, \omega)$, $\mathsf{D}$ & Dressed phonon propagator $2\omega_{\vect{Q}\nu}/(\omega^{2} - \omega^{2}_{\vect{Q}\nu} - \Pi_{\nu})$ & $\mathrm{eV}^{-1}$ & \labelcref{sec:6.4} \\

$M^{\pm}_{cv\nu}(k, Q)$, $M^{\pm}_{cv\nu}(k, q, Q)$ & One-electron phonon-assisted amplitude summed over all intermediate bands $p$, upper sign emission: with two arguments the optical amplitude of the velocity vertex, with three the dimensionless density amplitude at momentum transfer $\vect{q}$; $M^{\pm}_{cv\nu}(\vect{k}, \vect{Q}; \hat{e})$ the optical amplitude along the polarization $\hat{e}$, the $\vect{q} \to 0$ limit of $(\omega/q)M^{\pm}(\vect{k}, \vect{q}, \vect{Q})$ along $\hat{e} = \hat{q}$; the argument count is part of the name & 1 (a velocity); 1 & \labelcref{sec:6.5} \\

$\vect{S}_{e}$, $\vect{S}_{N}$ & Spin of a target electron $(\vect{\sigma}/2)$ and of a nucleon in the operator basis & 1 & \labelcref{sec:8.1} \\
$\mathcal{J}^{\alpha\beta}_{s}(\vect{q})$, $\mathcal{J}_{e}$, $\mathcal{J}$ & Spin-current operator of species $s, \sum_{j} \tfrac{1}{2}\{\vect{p}_{j}^{\alpha}/m_{s}, \ee^{\ii \vect{q}\cdot \vect{r}_{j}}\}S_{j}^{\beta}$ & 1 & \labelcref{sec:8.1} \\
